pillars.name: Pain → Solution
pillars.brief: Name a distributor pain (stock mismatch, GST panic, slow billing, multi-firm chaos) and show how VyaparTrack solves it.

pillars.name: Feature spotlight
pillars.brief: One feature, shown as a benefit. (Multi-firm switch, auto GST split, FIFO costing, GRN→auto sell price, credit notes, GSTR-3B summary, bulk import.)

pillars.name: Educational / how-to
pillars.brief: GST basics, inventory best practices, margin tips, expiry-loss control. Builds trust, highly shareable/saveable.

pillars.name: Social proof / use-case
pillars.brief: "A distributor running 3 firms can…" (generic scenarios ONLY unless real testimonial data is supplied).

pillars.name: Seasonal / festive / filing-cycle
pillars.brief: Month-end, GST filing dates, Diwali/Holi stocking season, financial year-end, new-year planning.

pillars.name: Behind-the-scenes / brand
pillars.brief: Product updates, team, "built in India for Indian distributors", roadmap teasers.

feature_pool: HSN on every line + Bill of Supply for exempt goods
Buy price captured at GRN, cascading margins to sell price
Purchase order → multi-godown GRN → stock → sales order → GST bill flow
Bulk import for onboarding existing data

cadence_per_week.note: As specified in the original brief; tune later from analytics.
